knowledge_point.title: Describing an Entry of a Matrix in Index Notation

question.:question/problem:
Consider the highlighted entry of the matrix $B$ given below. Describe it in terms of ${b}_{ij}.$

$$
B=\begin{bmatrix}2 & 6 & 9 & -7 \\ -9 & 6 & -1 & 8 \\ -2 & -3 & 6 & 8 \\ 8 & 6 & 3 & \boxed{-5}\end{bmatrix}
$$
question.:question/worked-solution: The entry lies at the intersection of the $4$th row and $4$th column. Hence, we have ${b}_{44}=-5.$
